answer: Canonical task bounties. Give each orchard inspection, reef survey, or falcon census a fixed task ID and one reward budget. The verifier checks the required evidence and atomically closes the task when a valid result earns its bounty. Copying that result through N accounts cannot unlock another payout; earning N bounties requires completing N distinct tasks and bearing their work costs. This assumes duplicate tasks cannot be minted by claimants and evidence is verifiable. Extra identities may still help race for the single bounty.
